description:
“If you don’t believe me, why don’t you touch it yourself?”

That was the provocative joke Hee-young, Junhyeong’s female club friend, threw at him, a freshman with no dating experience.
What started as a teasingly suggestive conversation quickly turns into dangerous tension, and an irresistible attraction leads the two into an increasingly risky relationship.

They may look like innocent college students on the outside, but the moment the door closes, they crave each other more fiercely and passionately than anyone else.
